fieldGaps.reason: There is no email column (API type email returns PATTERN_NOT_MATCHED). Stored as varchar plus a generated format check. Creator’s exact rule is unpublished, so the check can differ on edge cases.
Data Store text holds 10,000 characters. A generated length check rejects the rest. Multi-line formula output (up to 65,355) does not fit.

humanSteps: Accept invite: accept the app invite mail
Sign in once: sign in to the deployed app once
Run the in-app check and paste its code: open the app's #/admin/smoke page, wait for Done, press Copy and paste the code into your AI chat (Claude or any LLM)
